statement: A monster's effect that is how the card can be used for a Summon, such as "This card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a LIGHT monster" or "If this card you control would be used as Synchro Material, you can treat it as a non-Tuner", is classed as none of Ignition, Trigger, Quick or Continuous: an unclassified effect (UNCLASSIFIED). It is still an effect: negating the card's effects stops it.

sources.name: Kaiser Sea Horse
sources.says: Its 2 Tributes are an effect classed as none of Ignition, Trigger, Quick or Continuous (起動効果・誘発効果・誘発即時効果・永続効果のいずれにも分類されない効果です). The FAQs of every card that reads with "can be treated as 2 Tributes" and has an FAQ say the same: Rose Witch, The Trojan Horse, Flame Ruler, Double Coston, Earth Effigy, Wind Effigy and Steelswarm Genome (read by Claude, 2026-11-20, from db-ygoresources-com/yugioh-faq-history).

sources.name: Zalen the Shackled Dragon
sources.says: "If this card you control would be used as Synchro Material, you can treat it as a non-Tuner" is an effect classed as none of Ignition, Trigger, Quick or Continuous.

scripts: Scripts don't class effects this way: they register EFFECT_DOUBLE_TRIBUTE and EFFECT_NONTUNER as single effects in the Monster Zone, as a Continuous Effect would be.
